records.key: spaCR can tell you when a long run finishes or fails: on this computer's desktop, by email, in Slack or Microsoft Teams, through ntfy or a webhook. Nothing is sent until you switch it on here. Passwords and addresses that work like passwords are kept in the system keyring.
records.source: spaCR can tell you when a long run finishes or fails: on this computer's desktop, by email, in Slack or Microsoft Teams, through ntfy or a webhook. Nothing is sent until you switch it on here. Passwords and addresses that work like passwords are kept in the system keyring.
records.translation: spaCR은 긴 실행이 끝나거나 실패할 때 이 컴퓨터의 데스크톱, 이메일, Slack 또는 Microsoft Teams, ntfy 또는 웹후크로 알려 드릴 수 있습니다. 여기서 켜기 전에는 아무것도 보내지 않습니다. 비밀번호와 비밀번호처럼 쓰이는 주소는 시스템 키링에 보관됩니다.

records.key: Post an Adaptive Card to a Microsoft Teams channel or chat through a workflow webhook. Default off.
records.source: Post an Adaptive Card to a Microsoft Teams channel or chat through a workflow webhook. Default off.
records.translation: 워크플로 웹후크를 통해 Microsoft Teams 채널 또는 채팅에 Adaptive Card를 게시합니다. 기본값은 꺼짐입니다.

records.key: The webhook address from a Teams workflow configured to allow Anyone to call it. Anyone with the address can post, so it is kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.source: The webhook address from a Teams workflow configured to allow Anyone to call it. Anyone with the address can post, so it is kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.translation: Anyone이 호출할 수 있도록 설정한 Teams 워크플로의 웹후크 주소입니다. 주소를 아는 사람은 누구나 게시할 수 있으므로 비밀번호처럼 보관됩니다. 비워 두면 저장된 주소를 유지합니다. 기본값은 비어 있음입니다.

records.key: Teams webhook
records.source: Teams webhook
records.translation: Teams 웹후크

records.key: Webhook
records.source: Webhook
records.translation: 알림 웹후크

records.key: Send a JSON object with title, body and failed fields to the webhook below. The body contains the run summary and output path; failed is true when the run failed. Default off.
records.source: Send a JSON object with title, body and failed fields to the webhook below. The body contains the run summary and output path; failed is true when the run failed. Default off.
records.translation: title, body, failed 필드가 있는 JSON 객체를 아래 웹후크로 보냅니다. body에는 실행 요약과 출력 경로가 포함되며, 실행이 실패하면 failed는 true입니다. 기본값은 꺼짐입니다.

records.key: The HTTP or HTTPS address that receives the JSON notification. Kept like a password because webhook addresses can contain access keys. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.source: The HTTP or HTTPS address that receives the JSON notification. Kept like a password because webhook addresses can contain access keys. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.translation: JSON 알림을 받는 HTTP 또는 HTTPS 주소입니다. 웹후크 주소에는 액세스 키가 포함될 수 있으므로 비밀번호처럼 보관됩니다. 비워 두면 저장된 주소를 유지합니다. 기본값은 비어 있음입니다.

records.key: Webhook address
records.source: Webhook address
records.translation: 웹후크 주소

records.key: An optional bearer token for the webhook. Kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.source: An optional bearer token for the webhook. Kept like a password. Leave empty to keep the saved one. Default empty.
records.translation: 웹후크에 사용할 선택 사항인 Bearer 토큰입니다. 비밀번호처럼 보관됩니다. 비워 두면 저장된 토큰을 유지합니다. 기본값은 비어 있음입니다.

records.key: Webhook access token
records.source: Webhook access token
records.translation: 웹후크 액세스 토큰

records.key: Delete all saved notification passwords, webhook addresses, topics and tokens from the keyring and from spaCR's own file, at once. Default kept.
records.source: Delete all saved notification passwords, webhook addresses, topics and tokens from the keyring and from spaCR's own file, at once. Default kept.
records.translation: 저장된 모든 알림 비밀번호, 웹후크 주소, 주제 및 토큰을 키링과 spaCR 자체 파일에서 한꺼번에 삭제합니다. 기본값은 유지입니다.

records.key: Relative cost per condition: one replicate, one well within a replicate, or one field within a well. Use common units; zero ignores this cost. Default {default:g}.
records.source: Relative cost per condition: one replicate, one well within a replicate, or one field within a well. Use common units; zero ignores this cost. Default {default:g}.
records.translation: 조건별 상대 비용: 반복 하나, 반복 내 웰 하나 또는 웰 내 시야 하나의 비용입니다. 공통 단위를 사용하세요. 0이면 이 비용을 무시합니다. 기본값은 {default:g}입니다.

records.translation: 최대 반복 수

records.translation: 조건당 최대 웰 수

records.source: Largest count considered: biological replicates per condition, wells per condition per replicate, or fields per well. Default {default}.
records.translation: 고려할 최대 개수: 조건당 생물학적 반복 수, 각 반복에서 조건당 웰 수 또는 웰당 시야 수입니다. 기본값은 {default}입니다.

records.key: No design within {replicates} replicates, {wells} wells per condition and {fields} fields per well reaches the target power.
records.source: No design within {replicates} replicates, {wells} wells per condition and {fields} fields per well reaches the target power.
records.translation: 최대 {replicates}개 반복, 각 반복에서 조건당 {wells}개 웰 및 웰당 {fields}개 시야 이내의 어떤 설계도 목표 검정력에 도달하지 못합니다.
